args.command:
for bc in 8 16 32 64 128 256 512 1024 4096 65536; do
  lo=$((bc/2)); hi=$bc
  # find max count n in (bc/2, bc] with final bucket_count == bc
  # invariant: lo gives bc (check), hi gives > bc
  while [ $((hi-lo)) -gt 1 ]; do
    mid=$(( (lo+hi)/2 ))
    out=$(/workspace/dataset/test18_executable --a $mid)
    got=$(echo $out | cut -d' ' -f2)
    if [ "$got" = "$bc" ]; then lo=$mid; else hi=$mid; fi
  done
  echo "bc=$bc max_n_keeping=$lo ratio=$(python3 -c "print($lo/$bc)")"
done
